title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 8 (Processing of Personally Identifying Information)
Where unavoidable for performing affairs concerning the commissioning of honorary Mayors, heads of Gun and honorary heads of Dong, Ri, Eup and Myeon under Articles 2 and 6, the Minister of the Interior and Safety and Governors may process data containing resident registration numbers or passport numbers under Article 19, subparagraph 1 or 2, of the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act. <Amended on July 26, 2017.>
